title: Tightest Channel Spacing
brief: A spectrum allocation service keeps assigned radio frequencies in a binary search tree: every frequency in a node's left subtree is lower than the node's, and every frequency in its right subtree is higher. Regulators want to know how tightly any two assigned channels are packed.

Implement tightestSpacing(root), where root is the TreeNode at the root of the allocation tree and each node's value is a frequency, and return the smallest difference between any two assigned frequencies.
